name: @w6w-apps/cloudconvert
description: Convert, compress and manipulate files with CloudConvert's job/task pipeline.

w6w.longDescription:
CloudConvert converts, compresses, watermarks and otherwise transforms files through a job/task pipeline: a job is a small graph of tasks (typically an import, a conversion, and an export), and this app covers the job and task lifecycle end to end — create, inspect, wait for, list and delete jobs; inspect, wait for, cancel, retry, list and delete the tasks inside them.

The centre of gravity is `convert-url`, a one-shot action that builds and runs the whole import-URL -> convert -> export-URL graph on CloudConvert's synchronous host and hands back the converted file's download URL directly, for the common case of converting one file without polling. `job-create` and `job-create-and-wait` expose the full task graph as CloudConvert itself defines it (import from S3/Azure/GCS/OpenStack/SFTP/a base64 or raw string, convert, optimize, watermark, thumbnail, merge, and more) for anything more elaborate than the one-shot path.

Browser-style local-file upload (`import/upload`) is deliberately not covered — see the README for why — so every action here works with files already reachable by URL or by one of CloudConvert's cloud-storage import/export operations.
